285560: Anzu Hoshino is the protagonist who bears the "anti-heroine" attribute. She is a high school first year who claims her 3 great desires are video games, cat, and chocolate.
285561: Riri is a wizard who can do romantic magic with their star shaped magic wand.
287816: A cold and reserved boy who is Anzu's first romance candidate. He is popular among women due to his good looks but tends to avoid them, rejecting any romantic proposals outright. He meets Anzu in a meet cute where she accidentally bumps into him and breaks his phone.
287817: A wealthy boy who is not in touch with the lives of "peasants", also set up by Riri for Anzu. He meets Anzu in a twist on a classic anime meet cute, where she is running late to school and is hit by his car.
287818: Hijiri Koganei's chauffeur who cares for him deeply. He offers romantic advice to Hijiri, and at times appears as a joke romance candidate, considered equally handsome to the candidates.
287819: Anzu's best female friend at school. She treasures her bond with Anzu as Anzu has defended her during her difficult time in middle school. She met Anzu when she was shoved down by a jealous school bully, and Anzu forced the bully to apologize.
287820: Tsukasa Kazuki's an easygoing and reliable friend. He is somewhat air-headed and oblivious, but because of his kind personality, Tsukasa can let his guard down around him. He is puzzled by Tsukasa's cold attitude to girls and often apologizes on his friend's behalf.
287821: The "childhood friend" that Riri set up for Anzu. Anzu originally believed him to be a random hot guy brainwashed by Riri, but it is later revealed that he is in fact a childhood friend of Anzu.
